description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of the GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES environment variable and related git rev-parse commands, including handling of symlinks and directory prefixes.

methods.name: test_prefix
methods.description: Defines a test to check if 'git rev-parse --show-prefix' outputs the expected prefix.

methods.name: test_fail
methods.description: Defines a test to check if 'git rev-parse --show-prefix' fails with code 128.
